name: Salah widget pre-overhaul compatibility snapshot

source.donor: main, independently matched to production; no renderer PR used

deployment.correspondence: HTTP 200 response bodies for root index.html and config.js equal pinned Git blobs byte-for-byte; no runtime deployment transformation observed

adaptations: V1-only settings key and storage probe
One-time import of valid schema-1 root settings into V1; root is read-only
V1 reset retains import marker to prevent resurrection; caches are not imported

storage.migration: Once on first local/preferLocal load with no V1 settings or marker, validate schema 1 and copy normalized settings. Missing/invalid data is not retried. Reset retains marker. Root data is never changed. No cache migration.
storage.limitations: Same-origin namespace isolation is not a security boundary. Browser partitioning or blocked/quota-limited storage can prevent migration/persistence; existing session/coarse/manual fallback remains. Schema-1 validity cannot prove an arbitrary future root writer's semantics.

externalDependencies.purpose: Prayer times, timezone and Hijri date

localDependencyAudit: index.html -> relative config.js only. CSS, scripts, SVG filters and Moon image data are inline. No base, imports, workers, service worker, Cache API, IndexedDB or cookies. External social links remain external. Builder/installers are not runtime dependencies.
notices: Original file comments and embedded attribution preserved. No LICENSE/NOTICE file exists in the pinned source tree. Original credits identify Aladhan and Open-Meteo; remote font/assets remain provider-hosted.
knownLimitations: Clock, location, prayer dates, weather and external services remain live/mutable
Existing legacy appearance, browser behavior and fallback choices are preserved, including shadows
Public V1 deployment is pending an owner-authorized merge and successful Pages deployment

manifest.scope: index.html, config.js, VERSION.json; excludes itself and checkout-only .gitattributes; verifier anchors manifest digest outside v1
